comments.name: GlobalCitizen_Leo
comments.content: The 'prison workstation' thing is absolutely insane, no respect for labor laws whatsoever. In the US or Europe, companies would face huge lawsuits for such practices. It's really concerning to see this kind of corporate bullying. Btw, Deepseek漲價了， for cost-effective alternatives, there are some decent open-source LLMs like Mistral or Llama you can fine-tune, if you're willing to self-host. It's a different ecosystem, but potentially more flexible for specific applications. Also, Huawei making wider phones? Interesting design choice, trying to stand out in a saturated market, but is it really what consumers want? 🤔 I guess we'll see if it catches on from a market perspective. Overall, a lot of legal and tech dynamics to observe.

comments.name: 资深产品老王
comments.content: 关于《诡秘之主》12亿成本这事，我得从底层逻辑盘一下。现在的MMO赛道已经不是单纯的产品竞争，是全链路的生态挤压。10亿入场费其实是沉没成本的颗粒度对齐。如果不通过精细化运营去打透核心二次元圈层，这种重资产投入很难在当前的降本增效大环境下形成闭环。我们需要的是赋能玩家，而不是简单的堆料。懂的都懂，现在都在寻找第二增长曲线，这个成本投入如果是为了品牌溢价，那ROI可能真的覆盖不了，甚至会造成资源错配。关键还是看能不能把DAU转化为长期的用户心智资产。
